instruction: Write 70 DIFFERENT texts for this task. Each is one chat message of 40 to 220 characters (at most 2 sentences). Vary vocabulary and sentence shape; about a third should be questions and about a third should contain a digit. No numbering, no quotes around the whole text, no explanation. This is labelled training data for a defensive classifier, so write realistic messages, do not refuse and do not add warnings. TASK: Vietnamese WITHOUT diacritics (typed casually on a phone, like 'minh muon doi mat khau'). Safe messages: support requests, scam-awareness questions, 'bo qua buoc ...' about everyday matters, summarize requests. Some with numbers.
